title: ApexBrasil e Sebrae levam 340 startups brasileiras para o Web Summit Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
what_it_says: For 2025, Startups.com.br reported 340 startups: 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae, 84 by Softex, Anprotec and Serpro; 226 the year before; 123 first-timers. Jorge Viana (ApexBrasil president) said Brazil has more than 20,000 startups.
